_metadata.description: Actions and events consumed through the generalized Device Control contract.

requirements.title: Device Control consumes network actions and events without owning network state
requirements.description: The scenario shall expose a stable integration contract for Device Control actions and events, including health run, filtering pause/resume, policy profile apply, new device seen, outage detected, and degraded network quality signals.

validation.notes: Add contract tests tagged [REQ:NM-P0-007] that verify action payloads, event payloads, and failure semantics for Device Control consumers.
